title: Certification
description: Represents a professional, academic, technical, or industry certification awarded to an individual.

name.title: Certification Name
name.description: The official name or title of the certification.

issuer.title: Issuing Organization
issuer.description: The organization, institution, committee, or person that issued the certification.

date.title: Certification Date
date.description: The year or date on which the certification was awarded.

dateLabel.title: Certification Date Label
dateLabel.description: The display format of the year or date on which the certification was awarded.

url.title: Certification URL
url.description: A URI linking to the certification, verification page, or related documentation. Null indicates that no URL is available.
